meta.name: git-rebase-workflow
meta.description: Guide Claude through safe git rebase workflows: interactive rebase, conflict resolution, squash strategies, and force-push safety. Use when the user asks "rebase my branch", "clean up commits", "squash commits before PR", "rebase onto main", "resolve rebase conflicts", or wants help with git history cleanup. 安全的 Git Rebase 工作流指南：交互式变基、冲突解决、 提交压缩策略和安全强制推送。
